name: GitHub Review: octocat/Hello-World
summary: Bounded repository review completed for octocat/Hello-World. Identified 2 finding(s), 1 verified standard(s), and 3 unassessed area(s) requiring deeper access.

findings.title: Missing Open Source License (LICENSE)
findings.observed: No declared license found in repository root.
findings.why_it_matters: Without a license, default copyright applies, making reuse or dependency integration legally ambiguous.
findings.action: Add an appropriate license (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0) to the repository root.
findings.how_to_verify: Verify GitHub recognizes the license badge in the repository sidebar.

findings.title: Missing Security Policy (`SECURITY.md`)
findings.observed: No `SECURITY.md` found in repository root or `.github/` folder.
findings.why_it_matters: External security researchers need a dedicated disclosure channel to report vulnerabilities privately.
findings.action: Create a `.github/SECURITY.md` file specifying your responsible disclosure email or GitHub Security Advisory process.
findings.how_to_verify: Confirm security policy appears under the Security tab in GitHub.

positive_observations.evidence: Repository is publicly reachable on default branch 'master'.

unassessed_areas.reason: Requires GitHub Organization / Repo admin permissions
